provenance.source: Handwritten 48 F7 F9 bytes, register values, and literal expected state; tests/cpu/generate_stage2_idiv_qword_error.py only serializes these constants. No assembler or semantic expected-value generator.
provenance.specification: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol.2A IDIV: RDX:RAX is the signed 128-bit dividend, RCX is the signed 64-bit divisor, and a quotient outside signed 64-bit range raises #DE. This input is signed 128-bit minimum divided by -1.
provenance.specification_version: Intel SDM Vol.2A revision 093 (253667-093US); project S2-20c
